item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
Triathlon

A triathlon is a race in which athletes swim, then cycle, then run set distances. The first person to complete the whole course is the winner.

Kathy, Barbara, and Sue competed with each other in a triathalon. The course they covered consisted of a 1 kilometer swim, followed by a 40 kilometer cycle ride, and then a 15 kilometer run.

B. Kathy was the fastest cyclist. She averaged 30 kilometers per hour for the 40 km ride. Barbara took 10 minutes more than Kathy, and Sue took 15 minutes more than Kathy.

Use this information to complete the table for cycling:

| Cycling | Kathy | Barbara | Sue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Time taken (minutes) | | | |

descriptors: Kathy 80, Barbara 90, Sue 95 (accept time given in hours and minutes)
Barbara 10 more than value for Kathy; Sue 15 more than value for Kathy
Kathy 80, at least one of others not given or incorrect.

The graph represents the distance and time of a hike taken by Joshua and Liam.

If they both started from the same place and walked in the same direction, at what time did they meet?

A line graph with a vertical axis labeled "Distance (kilometers)" marked from 0 to 5.5 in increments of 0.5 (labeled 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5). The horizontal axis is labeled "Time" with tick marks every 30 minutes from 8:00 to 12:30 (labeled 8:00, 8:30, 9:00, 9:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30). Two line segments are shown:
- One labeled "Joshua" begins at (8:00, 0) and ends with a solid dot at (12:00, 4.5).
- One labeled "Liam" begins at (9:00, 0) and ends with a solid dot at (11:00, 4.5).
The two lines intersect at time 10:00 and distance approximately 2.25 kilometers.
